recommendation: Test one fixed ETH opposing-breakout exit without changing live V58.
why_now: The latest resolved V58 ETH long reached 417.01 bps MFE and later stopped for -8.05 USD. At the stop boundary, the canonical five-minute market evidence recorded a fresh short breakout and strongly negative short-horizon returns, while the provider still authored a long intent because its execution side is intentionally the slower hourly structural direction.
evidence_reviewed: immutable V58 prefix through the resolved ETH close
ETH canonical breakout and precompression provider implementations and tests
282-trade development and 56-trade opened-final fixed-entry ETH control
rejected global R5 profit lock and persistent component-decay exit
observed_problem_or_opportunity: The live provider has no opposite-intent exit when a fresh completed-five-minute price breakout opposes the open position but the slower hourly SMA structure has not reversed. This is intended provider semantics rather than a dropped route, but it may surrender mature profit or delay a failing exit.
applicable_market_regime: An open ETH precompression-pullback lifecycle followed by a newly completed five-minute BREAKOUT onset whose point-in-time breakout direction opposes the position side.
alternatives_considered: global R2 and R5 static profit locks
reinterpret the provider's entry side as breakout direction
expected_upside: Close a position after a causally completed adverse breakout before the slower structural side changes, while leaving entries, ordinary noise, protective stops, fees, funding, and the 12-hour fallback unchanged.
main_risks_and_failure_modes: The hypothesis was motivated by one selected terminal path; five-minute breakout onsets can whipsaw; early exits can sacrifice recovery and right-tail continuation; the historical partitions are already opened; one-minute OHLC cannot reproduce private IOC latency or intrabar sequencing exactly.
validation_completed: The live decision trace, provider-side semantics, route identity, frozen historical inputs, prior rejected exit families, and current terminal economics were established before candidate outcomes were inspected.
validation_still_required: Test-first implementation, fixed-entry parity, exact completed-bar onset detection, next-open execution, venue-stop precedence, fees, official funding, slippage, five development folds, opened-final comparison, both-side attribution, drawdown, largest-winner sensitivity, and one additional decision-delay stress.

success_metrics.technical: Every control entry is reproduced exactly; every candidate exit maps to a completed-five-minute opposing breakout; no missing breakout-direction rows are guessed; venue protective stops retain precedence.
success_metrics.development: Candidate net and profit factor exceed the native control, candidate net excluding its largest winner is positive, maximum drawdown does not worsen, and at least three of five chronological folds have positive candidate net and positive delta versus control.
success_metrics.opened_final_60d: Candidate net and profit factor exceed native control, candidate net excluding its largest winner is positive, maximum drawdown does not worsen, and candidate long and short slices are both positive.
success_metrics.delay_stress: The candidate remains net-positive, above profit factor one, and better than control after one additional completed one-minute bar of decision delay.
success_metrics.disposition: A full pass permits only an approval-ready next-flat successor proposal plus a future-only monitor; any failed required condition rejects immediate live use.

failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any entry mismatch, non-causal onset, missing directional evidence, stop-precedence violation, development degradation, fold failure, opened-final reversal, side collapse, largest-winner dependence, drawdown degradation, or delay-stress failure rejects immediate live use. No live rollback applies because this experiment has no execution authority.
falsifier: Reject if the fixed candidate fails any declared technical or economic metric. Update only with a source-bound implementation correction or genuinely future source-compatible evidence, not by retuning the trigger on these already-opened windows.
